name: hugeicons
description: Hugeicons integration for Grok Build (MCP server + skills). Search 6,000+ Hugeicons icons by meaning, get the exact install command and import for React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, SolidJS, React Native, Flutter and the web font, and migrate a project to Hugeicons from lucide, Heroicons or react-icons. Resolves every icon name against the live catalog instead of guessing it.
